text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I want to create a circle across the sea.
Just as we did in Japan,
I want to connect heart to heart.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: And so, I wish to kindle hope.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...I know it might be reckless, but...
I believe this is what I am meant to do.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
With those legs and that unwavering resolve,
you have overcome every wall—
and I have watched over you ever since your
debut race.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Thus,
I have the utmost conviction. If it is you,
you will surely accomplish it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A short while after the start of March,
the challengers bound for the races in Dubai
departed from Japan.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I cannot afford to remain preoccupied
with the journeys of others.
First comes—the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I shall conquer the Grand Prix race and
seize the crown without fail next time.
choice_data_list: Yes, we shall claim victory withou...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On that day,
I was looking over the training menu for
today and the days ahead in preparation for
the Takarazuka Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: All of a sudden,

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Japan was struck by 'it'.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...An earthquake?!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, this is—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A deafening roar,
and tremors so violent one could hardly
remain standing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was an unprecedented catastrophe
that engulfed the whole of Japan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
'Bringing you the latest updates from the
disaster area—'
'Emergency relief efforts are still underway
around the clock.'
'Please remain alert for potential
aftershocks—'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Widespread soil liquefaction has been
reported across the region—"
"Transit systems throughout the metropolitan
area are completely suspended—"
"Utilities and emergency lifelines have been
temporarily cut off."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Is this... truly reality—?
.........

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so began the days of chaos.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Besides lending her support to the various
disaster relief
efforts led by the Rose Clan,
Rose Kingdom also—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Tracen Academy didn't suffer any major
damage.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
However, worn down by the current situation,
the number of students who confined themselves
to their rooms gradually grew.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...I am not one for witty words of
encouragement.
Yet, if there is anything I can do,
I have no desire to give up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the earthquake,
I tended to the students who had grown
disheartened,
overwhelmed by the somber mood of the
world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Knock, knock*)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Everyone tells me they haven't seen your
face in a while.
...Do you have a moment to talk?

text_block_list.name: Introverted Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry...
Um, right now... no matter what I do,
I get worn out so quickly...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...I see. That is only natural.
Once your spirits have recovered even a little,
please join us at the dining table.

text_block_list.name: Introverted Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
............
Thank you... very much...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Truthfully...
I can understand that feeling.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Every time I watch the news,
my heart aches. Yet at the same time,
I feel guilty for indulging in leisure.
...What one person can achieve alone feels
so agonizingly small.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
My heart feels adrift in midair—
and I cannot move forward as I should.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...
Hoping it would boost morale,
I even held dinner gatherings.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
However,
she didn't seem keen on participating in
the first place. Nothing could be done.
choice_data_list: Please do not overexert yourself e...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I am... fine.
Though I feel my own powerlessness all too
acutely.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I must search and move forward.
Doing what only I can do—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The days, as if drained of all color,
continued on.
